$comment: OpenSetlist dev seed — curated PUBLIC DOMAIN songs (texts/compositions pre-1930, PD in the US) for manual testing. Run `pnpm -C api db:seed` before a test pass: it wipes the group's songs/tags, ensures the dev admin login (admin@opensetlist.local / admin), and re-imports this file. Each section's content is ABC 2.1: quoted chord symbols inline on music lines, lyrics on w: lines with one syllable per note (hyphen-joined syllables within a word). Instrumental sections (Canon in D) have chords but no w: lines. Melodies are simplified dev harmonizations, not authoritative settings. Alpha seeding with the team's real repertoire stays with issue #17.
